comment: Cluster seeds, hand-authored 2026-07-28 from Vol. 1's six lanes + SUMMARY.md top-40 + playlist DNA. Seed artists are all confirmed-played. The model builder EXPANDS membership from playlist co-membership and session co-occurrence, and computes states from recency-weighted data — seeds are starting points, not the answer. Artists recommended in Vol. 1 (GoGo Penguin, Protomartyr, black midi, etc.) are deliberately absent: they are never-played.

clusters.name: Cosmic Groove
clusters.description: The Khruangbin/Jai Paul devotion lane — low-skip global groove, psych-funk, MPB lineage.

clusters.name: Jazz Bridge
clusters.description: Where Nujabes, Butcher Brown and the ambient-jazz session world meet.

clusters.name: Beats & IDM
clusters.description: The Nightmares On Wax / FlyLo / Aphex / Bicep lane — instrumental beats, IDM, UK bass.

clusters.name: Underground Rap
clusters.description: The DOOM/Griselda continuum — loop-digger rap, ATCQ lineage to Armand Hammer.

clusters.name: French Electronic
clusters.description: The Justice/Daft Punk bloodline — filter-house, Ed Banger energy.

clusters.name: The Punk Turn
clusters.description: The 2025–26 present tense — post-punk, noise rock, the Viagra Boys/Turnstile pivot.

clusters.name: The Mist
clusters.description: Behavioral cluster anchored on the morning mist playlist — 12% skip vs 22% global. Ambient-adjacent downtempo devotion listening.

clusters.name: Club Continuum
clusters.description: Jamie xx / Four Tet / KAYTRANADA — dancefloor and its afterhours.

clusters.name: Bass & EDM (legacy)
clusters.description: The 2015 origin story plus the 2023 Skrillex revival — expected dormant-or-revived state; the model decides from data.

clusters.name: House & Garage
clusters.description: Disclosure, Fred again.., Folamour — house, UK garage and their afterhours; the dancefloor door the club continuum never quite held.

clusters.name: Liquid
clusters.description: Drum & bass at its smoothest — High Contrast, Netsky, Maduk, Calibre, Hybrid Minds; liquid rollers over the crossover noise.

clusters.name: Dad/Boomer Rock
clusters.description: Steely Dan, Dire Straits, the Dead, the Stones, Fleetwood Mac — the classic-rock and jazz-rock shelf, heard whole and skipped least.
